sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.ja_search: Japanese fallback (rule 10): ja.wikipedia.org (Black Clover), the pixiv encyclopedia and the namu.wiki Japanese spell list, read through search summaries only (the hosts are not fetchable from the build machine).
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Painting Magic (brush and palette)
spells.note: Painting Magic page: a palette and a paintbrush are manifested; mode 0 of the book.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Spring of Restriction
spells.note: A paint-brush-drawn spring-like well that captures a target (supplementary).

spells.name: Painting Magic: Souterrain Groundswell
spells.note: NEW page. Figures ride waves of dirt and crash into the target, covering it in dirt.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Sirene's Game
spells.note: NEW page. Mermaids made of water crash into the target and douse it.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Deux Tempetes of Fire and Ice
spells.note: Two twisters, fire and water, that counter ice and fire spells.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Four-Headed Lindworm
spells.note: NEW page. A four-headed serpent whose heads breathe different elements.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Phantom Dragon Vouivre's Shout
spells.note: NEW page. A winged serpent-woman that fires a magical blast and can carry the user into the air.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Souterrain Giant
spells.note: NEW page. The upper body of a giant of dense earth rises from the ground; it can be broken apart (defensive).

spells.name: Painting Magic: God's Game
spells.note: A bearded figure that bends any spell fired at the user and sends it back at the attacker.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Master of Valhalla
spells.note: A giant winged-helmet warrior who raises tornadoes that tear opponents apart.

spells.name: Painted Menagerie
spells.note: LEGACY page locked to Rill since 0.34 (not on the wiki's list): kept in his set so it stays reachable.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Twilight of Valhalla
spells.note: NEW page. A many-storeyed hall and winged shield-maidens; after a delay allies inside gain power and cannot die easily (here: Regeneration, Resistance, Absorption).

spells.name: Painting Magic: Elemental Quintet
spells.note: The wiki's one compound spell: a combination of five elements.

spells.name: Painting Magic: Invasion of Heat-Infused Ice
spells.note: NEW shared page (pages15, batch 2, the spell that was 'planned' below). A magic circle pours ice over a target and holds it; it stays in the basic Painting book too.

planned.name: Invasion of Heat-Infused Ice
planned.note: A magic circle that pours ice over a target; supplementary. Not built yet (no page).

planned.name: Souterrain Groundswell / Sirene's Game as Lira's
planned.note: Lira shares the attribute; her grimoire is not in the CanonBook list.

notes: Not in his grimoire (kept in the basic Painting book): Souterrain Giant's Strong Arm (the wiki gives it to Lira, and a grimoire has only 12 page slots), Camouflage, Living Illustration and Counter Palette are this mod's own pages and were not found on the wiki's spell list for Rill.
